metadata.title: Table 19 At The Charity Gala
metadata.subtitle: Her snobbish uncle seated me behind the kitchen door—then I dropped a $12M anonymous bid that exposed his 15-year theft.

nodes.text: 7:30 PM · Grand Sovereign Auction Hall. Uncle Richard laughs loudly as he points you to Table 19—wedged right beside the noisy kitchen swing doors.
Table 1 is for millionaires bidding on the Jade Heirloom Box, Nolan. A broke mechanic like you belongs at Table 19 with the catering staff!
Uncle Richard, stop! That Jade Box belonged to my late father! Why are you auctioning it off?!
Because I own the estate now, Nina! Unless your broke boyfriend here has $12 million to buy it back, sit down and watch!
Once my buyer grabs the Jade Box tonight, nobody will ever find the hidden compartment inside.

nodes.prompt: Nina trembles with tears as the auction gavel rises:

options.label: Hold Nina’s hand & raise Paddle #19
options.player_reply_text: Don’t cry, Nina. Your father’s box is coming home tonight.

options.label: Verify your $50M VIP credit with Evelyn

nodes.text: You lift Paddle #19 smoothly as the bidding hits $5 million. Table 1 erupts in mocking laughter.
Evelyn, kick Table 19 out! He’s making fake bids—he couldn’t pay for a parking ticket!
You tap one encrypted code to Auction Chief Evelyn. Her earpiece chimes with a Triple-Platinum Sovereign Wire verification!
Good heavens... Paddle #19 is verified for $50 MILLION liquid credit! Stand down, Richard!
The entire hall gasps as Evelyn bows deeply toward Table 19 beside the kitchen door.
Twelve million dollars. Going once, Uncle Richard?

nodes.headline: The $12M Bid
nodes.teaser_text: Richard’s face drains of color—not just because you’re a secret billionaire, but because of what’s hidden INSIDE the Jade Box.

nodes.text: 7:45 PM · BANG! Evelyn’s gavel slams down: "Sold to Table 19 for twelve million dollars!"
Wait! Stop the sale! I withdraw the Jade Box from auction! I changed my mind!
Impossible, Richard! The hammer fell and Table 19’s $12M wire just cleared instantly!

nodes.caption: Sovereign Auction Settlement: $12,000,000 cleared in full from Nolan.

nodes.text: If Nina opens the false bottom of that box, I’m going to prison for life!

nodes.prompt: Richard lunges onto the stage to grab the Jade Box:

options.label: Have guards stop him & hand box to Nina
options.player_reply_text: Hands off, Richard. That box is legally mine now.

options.label: Inspect the false bottom live on stage

nodes.text: Two auction guards hold Richard back as Nina cradles her father’s box, feeling a loose click underneath.
Nolan... wait! There’s a hidden spring latch at the bottom of the jade tray!
You press the hidden jade lotus clasp under the spotlight. The velvet bottom pops open—revealing a red-stamped land deed!
Good lord... is that the original 1998 Harbor Waterfront Land Deed?!
Richard’s knees buckle as a horrified murmur sweeps across all twenty tables.
Uncle Richard... you told everyone my dad lost this land to debt! You STOLE it from him fifteen years ago!!

nodes.headline: The 15-Year Theft
nodes.teaser_text: Inside the Jade Box sits the $90M original land deed—and the forged transfer Richard used is about to implode.

nodes.text: 8:00 PM · Private VIP Vault Room. Evelyn and your legal counsel examine the original deed under UV light.
Evelyn reports: "Land Registry confirmed it! The deed Richard mortgaged to the bank is a forged duplicate—this one is 100% real!"
Alert flashes: "Authentic 1998 Waterfront Deed confirmed! Richard’s bank title is a forgery!"
And why was I pretending to be a mechanic, Nina? Because I’m the CEO of Horizon Holdings—the developer Richard tried to sell your dad’s land to last month.

nodes.caption: Original 1998 Waterfront Land Deed — sole ownership vested in Nina’s late father.

nodes.prompt: Richard pounds on the VIP glass yelling for his lawyer:

options.label: Let police serve the forgery warrant now
options.player_reply_text: Open the door, Evelyn. The police captain is right outside.

options.label: Show Richard the Horizon contract he signed

nodes.text: Officers step into the corridor and read Richard his rights for $90M real-estate fraud.
Nina! Tell Nolan we’re family! You can’t send your own uncle to prison!
You slide Horizon’s $10M deposit receipt under the glass: "You took my company’s earnest money on stolen land—that’s federal wire fraud too."
YOU are the CEO of Horizon?! Oh god... I’m finished!!
Nina looks up at you with awe and tears of gratitude—her fifteen-year nightmare finally cracking open.
You went undercover just to verify my dad’s land—and fell in love with me along the way?

nodes.headline: The Confession
nodes.teaser_text: Richard tries one desperate move from the police car—trying to liquidate the family house before dawn.

nodes.text: 11:15 PM · Rain taps against the limousine window as Evelyn forwards an urgent county-clerk alert.
Nolan, Richard’s wife just tried to sign an emergency quitclaim deed to sell Nina’s childhood home for cash!
My mom’s garden is in that house! Can we stop them in time?!

nodes.transcript: [calm command] "Already three steps ahead. Horizon’s legal team just filed an emergency court freeze on every asset Richard touched."

nodes.text: Tell my wife the notary refused to sign—the whole estate is frozen!

nodes.prompt: Richard’s wife calls Nina crying and begging for mercy:

options.label: Demand she hand over the keys tonight
options.player_reply_text: Leave the keys on the porch by midnight and we won’t add you to the lawsuit.

options.label: Have Horizon renovate the childhood home

nodes.text: Ten minutes later, the security camera shows Richard’s wife dropping the brass keys in the mailbox and driving off.
We got my parents’ house back!! Thank you, Nolan!
You dispatch Horizon’s top architects to restore Nina’s mother’s rose garden and turn the waterfront into a landmark park.
My parents would be smiling down at us right now...
The rain clears as dawn approaches over the harbor waterfront—now legally back in Nina’s name.
Court registry updated! Every square inch of the $90M waterfront belongs to Nina!

nodes.headline: Reclaimed Heritage
nodes.teaser_text: Tomorrow morning you return to the auction hall—for a surprise Table 19 will never forget.

nodes.text: 11:00 AM · Harbor Waterfront. Horizon’s board and city officials gather for the groundbreaking ceremony.
All the snobs from Table 1 are begging for an invitation to Nina’s new Waterfront Tower!
Tell them we reserved Table 19 right beside the kitchen door for them!

nodes.transcript: [chuckling warmly] "And the $12M from the charity auction just funded three children’s hospitals across the city!"

nodes.text: Prosecutor offered 12 years... I should have never mocked Table 19.

nodes.prompt: Before cutting the golden ribbon, you pull out a velvet ring box:

options.label: Propose to Nina beside the harbor view
options.player_reply_text: No more secrets, Nina. Will you marry this "mechanic"?

options.label: Name the landmark tower after Nina’s father

nodes.text: Nina throws her arms around your neck laughing through happy tears as the crowd erupts in cheers.
YES! A thousand times yes!!
The giant silk drape drops, unveiling "THE LINH MEMORIAL WATERFRONT" in gleaming gold letters.
You honored my father in front of the whole city... I love you so much!
Golden confetti drifts over the harbor as Table 19’s legend becomes the city’s favorite love story.
One last private dinner tonight—at Table 1, reserved exclusively for the two of you!

nodes.headline: Reserved For Two
nodes.teaser_text: From the noisy table behind the kitchen to the top of the skyline—one final toast seals your forever.

nodes.text: 8:00 PM · Sovereign Rooftop Terrace. Candles flicker on a single table labeled "Table 19" overlooking the illuminated harbor.
You actually asked Evelyn to put the "Table 19" sign on our engagement table?!
Of course. It’s our lucky number now.

nodes.transcript: [warm toast] "To the couple who turned a $12M auction into the sweetest justice of the decade!"

nodes.text: Best night of my whole life.

nodes.prompt: Raise your champagne under the harbor stars:

options.label: Toast to your future together
options.player_reply_text: To us, Nina. No more hiding, only building.

options.label: Gift Nina the Jade Box with world-tour tickets

nodes.text: Glasses clink softly as harbor lights dance across the dark water.
Forever starts tonight, Nolan.
Nina lifts the jade lid and gasps—inside are first-class tickets to Paris, Kyoto, and Zurich!
Best surprise ever!! Pack your bags, Mr. CEO!
Hand in hand, you watch the harbor skyline—where truth, love, and karma aligned perfectly.
Going once, going twice... sold to forever.

nodes.headline: Act 2 · The Harbor Cartel
nodes.teaser_text: Before the rooftop candles burn down, Evelyn sends an urgent red alert—a ruthless port syndicate just filed a 15-year-old maritime mortgage claiming THEY own Nina’s $90M waterfront!

nodes.text: 10:30 PM · Sovereign Rooftop Lounge. Harbor fog rolls in as Evelyn rushes over with an emergency maritime-court filing.
A port cartel called IronAnchor Holdings just slapped a midnight injunction on Horizon Waterfront—claiming Nina’s father defaulted on a $40M maritime mortgage fifteen years ago!

nodes.caption: Yellowed Maritime Mortgage Lien—stamped with a harbor registry seal that threatens to halt construction at sunrise.

nodes.text: That’s impossible! My father paid off every shipping loan before I turned ten—I remember him celebrating with the harbor master!
Then where did the payoff receipt go? Wait—Uncle Richard managed the estate for fifteen years. He must have sold this fake lien to IronAnchor before he got arrested!

nodes.prompt: IronAnchor’s bulldozers plan to seal the waterfront gate at 8:00 AM:

options.label: Check the auction vault for the twin seal
options.player_reply_text: Evelyn, did Uncle Richard consign anything else besides the Jade Box? A maritime mortgage needs a matching Harbor Seal to be cleared.

options.label: Rush to Nina’s father’s old boathouse
options.player_reply_text: Nina, did your father keep duplicate shipping ledgers at the old Pier 7 boathouse? Let’s check it before IronAnchor’s thugs get there!

nodes.text: Hold on! The auction ledger shows Richard tried to pawn a jade "Harbor Seal" last week—then suddenly pulled it back after a meeting at our hotel!
Yes! Dad had a brass locker behind the dry-dock office—nobody besides me remembers the combination!
As you race down the elevator toward the harbor road, Evelyn’s urgent call flashes across your dashboard screen.
Don’t go to Pier 7 unarmed—my night watchman just spotted IronAnchor’s men breaking into the Sovereign archive vault!

nodes.headline: Raid On The Vault
nodes.teaser_text: The port cartel isn’t just using lawyers—they’re hunting the missing Harbor Seal in the dead of night.

nodes.text: 11:15 PM · Harbor Waterfront Road. Foghorns echo across the black water as Evelyn’s encrypted line rings urgently.
They hit our auction vault looking for the Harbor Seal—when they didn’t find it, my guard overheard them heading straight for Pier 7’s old boathouse!

nodes.transcript: [urgent voicemail] "Watch out! IronAnchor’s men didn’t find the Harbor Seal in my vault—they’re racing to Pier 7 boathouse right now!"

nodes.text: We’re only two minutes from Pier 7! If they burn Dad’s old shipping ledgers, we’ll never prove the mortgage was paid off!
Kill the headlights and park behind the lighthouse. I already alerted harbor police—let’s catch them red-handed!

nodes.prompt: A dim flashlight beam flickers inside the Pier 7 boathouse:

options.label: Record the intruder from the catwalk
options.player_reply_text: Stay beside me on the upper walkway, Nina—let my phone capture their face and the license plate outside!

options.label: Sound the pier foghorn to flush him out
options.player_reply_text: Hit the boathouse foghorn switch! He’ll panic, drop the ledgers, and run straight toward harbor police!

nodes.text: Got a clear shot as he ducked out the back corridor—wait, he tripped on the wet dock and dropped his phone!
BRAAAMP! He bolted empty-handed—and smashed his own burner phone against the dock bollard while sprinting away!
You step into the shadowed boathouse corridor—the brass locker is pried halfway open, and a dark silhouette vanishes into the fog.
Good—Dad’s brass locker is still intact. And look at the security monitor by the door: it caught the intruder’s shadow clearly.

nodes.headline: The Dark Pier Corridor
nodes.teaser_text: The intruder fled into the fog, leaving behind a shattered burner phone—and a chilling link straight back to Uncle Richard.

nodes.text: 11:35 PM · Pier 7 Boathouse Office. You pull the motion-triggered corridor snapshot while Nina unlocks her father’s brass locker.

nodes.caption: Pier 7 boathouse corridor cam: Tall intruder in a harbor-authority coat slipping out the back passage at 11:21 PM.

nodes.text: Wait—look at the brass locker! The payoff ledger is gone... only a torn carbon-copy stub remains, signed by a Harbor Registry Deputy!
A harbor-authority coat?! That means IronAnchor has an insider INSIDE the City Land Registry who helped Uncle Richard erase the original payoff!
Tell IronAnchor’s boss not to worry—even from jail, my friend at the Registry wiped the payoff ledger fifteen years ago!

nodes.prompt: Someone is using Richard’s phone from outside—or via a corrupt lawyer:

options.label: Bag the smashed burner phone for forensics
options.player_reply_text: Never mind the torn paper—this smashed burner phone on the wet dock is gold. My tech team can pull its GPS log in an hour!

options.label: Inspect the Jade Box back at the vault
options.player_reply_text: Wait—if Richard’s registry friend wiped the paper ledger, why were IronAnchor’s men STILL hunting the Jade Box’s twin seal tonight?

nodes.text: Brilliant! My forensic engineer is already on standby—send the shattered unit over right now!
Because the bank archive can’t be altered without the Harbor Seal’s serial number! Wait—let me check my father’s Jade Box again!
Rain starts tapping softly on the boathouse roof as an arrogant voice message arrives from Uncle Richard’s defense attorney.
Uncle Richard actually had his lawyer send us a voice taunt from the jail visiting room...

nodes.headline: Uncle Richard’s Leverage
nodes.teaser_text: Richard thinks his corrupt Registry ally makes him untouchable—unaware the shattered phone on Pier 7 is about to speak.

nodes.text: 12:10 AM · Sovereign Vault Study. Rain streaks the windowpanes as you play the smug voice message Uncle Richard recorded for his lawyer.

nodes.transcript: [smug chuckle] "Still playing billionaire, Table 19? Tomorrow at noon the Registry hands your $90M waterfront to IronAnchor—unless you drop ALL charges against me!"

nodes.text: He’s using IronAnchor to blackmail us out of his prison sentence! What a monster—my own uncle!
Don’t worry, Nina. Blackmail only works when the villain holds all the cards—and Evelyn’s lab just finished reading the smashed phone.
Bingo! The shattered burner’s GPS chip survived! Before the intruder ran to Pier 7, he spent TWO HOURS inside Suite 402 at the Grand Sovereign Hotel!

nodes.prompt: You have 11 hours before IronAnchor’s noon foreclosure hearing:

options.label: Pull the GPS track & Suite 402 guest log
options.player_reply_text: Evelyn, cross-check who checked into Suite 402 tonight—and match it against the Land Registry’s senior staff!

options.label: Examine the Jade Box clasp under UV light
options.player_reply_text: Nina, bring your father’s Jade Box under this lamp—why does the bottom feel three centimeters thicker than the inside depth?

nodes.text: Hotel night manager is pulling the encrypted keycard check-in record right now! We’ll have a name by dawn!
Wait... Dad always used to twist the jade lotus petal counterclockwise when he locked up his study! Let me try!
Evelyn forwards the recovered GPS map of the smashed burner phone—a glowing red route linking Pier 7 straight to Suite 402.
Look at that GPS trace, Nina. Tomorrow morning, the corrupt Registry deputy won’t know what hit him.

nodes.headline: The Smashed Burner
nodes.teaser_text: The recovered GPS points straight to Suite 402—and one twist of the Jade Box clasp is about to unlock a 15-year secret.

nodes.text: 12:40 AM · Sovereign Vault Study. Rain patters against the glass as Evelyn displays the recovered GPS trail beside your father-in-law’s Jade Box.

nodes.caption: Recovered GPS track from the Pier 7 intruder’s smashed phone: departed Suite 402 at 11:02 PM, arrived Pier 7 at 11:19 PM.

nodes.text: Rock-solid forensic chain! Now hand economic police the GPS log—and Nina, twist that jade lotus petal counterclockwise!
CLICK!! Oh my god—the entire velvet bottom of the Jade Box just popped open! There’s a hidden compartment inside!
Wait—is that an imperial-green jade cylinder wrapped in oilcloth?! That’s the legendary missing HARBOR SEAL!

nodes.prompt: Beneath the Harbor Seal sits a sealed envelope in Nina’s father’s handwriting:

options.label: Read her father’s hidden letter first
options.player_reply_text: Open the envelope carefully, Nina. Your father hid it under a double lock for a reason.

options.label: Scan the Harbor Seal’s bank serial code
options.player_reply_text: Evelyn, read the 12-digit clearance number carved into the base of the Harbor Seal—pull the national bank archive right now!

nodes.text: Oh no... Dad wrote that IronAnchor’s boss didn’t just fake the mortgage—he sabotaged Dad’s cargo ship fifteen years ago, and Uncle Richard helped him!
FOUND IT! The Central Maritime Bank still has the immutable digital clearance: Nina’s father paid off the entire $40M mortgage in FULL—14 years ago!
Tears fall onto the yellowed parchment as the truth of fifteen years finally steps out of the shadows.
Hold onto that Harbor Seal, Nina. Tomorrow at noon, we’re not just saving the waterfront—we’re avenging your father.

nodes.headline: Mid-Season Twist · The Twin Jade Secret
nodes.teaser_text: Inside the Jade Box’s hidden drawer lies the real Harbor Seal—and proof of a 15-year betrayal that shocks even Evelyn.

nodes.text: 8:15 AM · Horizon Legal Command. Morning sunlight cuts across the table where the jade Harbor Seal rests beside the 14-year-old bank clearance.
Read this final line from my father’s letter: "Richard sold my shipping routes to IronAnchor for a kickback—if he ever auctions this box, trust only the one who buys it back for love."
Your father knew Table 19 would save you fifteen years before we even met. Now let’s finish off IronAnchor and their corrupt deputy.
Alert! IronAnchor’s lawyers just moved the foreclosure hearing UP to 10:00 AM—trying to ambush the Land Registry before we arrive!
I’m already at the City Land Registry lobby with the filing clerks—and IronAnchor’s boss just walked in with twenty armed bodyguards!

nodes.prompt: IronAnchor is trying to push through an illegal foreclosure order in 90 minutes:

options.label: Send economic police to the Registry hall
options.player_reply_text: Stay right where the lobby cameras can see you, Nina! I’m bringing economic police AND the Central Bank clearance!

options.label: Grab Suite 402’s hotel keycard record
options.player_reply_text: Evelyn, pick up the certified Suite 402 keycard log from the hotel—I want to slap the deputy’s own hotel check-in right onto his desk!

nodes.text: Hurry! The corrupt deputy just locked the hearing room doors to fast-track IronAnchor’s stamp!
Got the Suite 402 keycard log in my hand! It’s registered directly under the Deputy’s personal corporate card—heading to the Registry now!
Suddenly, your phone blares with an urgent incoming call from Nina inside the City Land Registry.
Hold on, Nina—I’m five minutes away and bringing the hammer down!

nodes.headline: Ambush At The Registry
nodes.teaser_text: The corrupt deputy is about to stamp the illegal foreclosure—unless you reach the hearing room before the ink hits paper.

nodes.text: 9:48 AM · City Boulevard. Your car weaves through morning traffic as Nina’s urgent call flashes on speaker.
[urgent] "They’re calling the foreclosure roll five minutes early! IronAnchor’s lawyer says if you don’t appear in two minutes, the deed transfers by default!"

nodes.transcript: [panting voicemail] "Pick up! They started the foreclosure vote early—get up to Room 300 right now before the deputy stamps it!"

nodes.text: Just pulled up to the Registry steps! Stall them for sixty seconds—Evelyn and the economic police unit are stepping out of the elevator right behind me!
Here’s the certified Suite 402 keycard record! The Deputy checked in at 9:30 PM last night, left at 11:02 PM, and hit Pier 7 seventeen minutes later!

nodes.prompt: You stride up to the closed double doors of Hearing Room 300:

options.label: Push open the doors & display the Jade Seal
options.player_reply_text: Hold that stamp, Deputy! Before you touch a single inch of Horizon Waterfront, take a good look at the real Harbor Seal!

options.label: Project the Suite 402 keycard log first
options.player_reply_text: Don’t stop there—put the Suite 402 hotel keycard AND the Pier 7 GPS map on the hearing room screen!

nodes.text: The Deputy’s hand froze in mid-air! IronAnchor’s boss just turned whiter than the tablecloth!
Every official in the room just gasped! The Deputy tried to bolt from his chair and bumped straight into an economic police officer!
Silence crashes over Room 300 as you place the Suite 402 hotel keycard record directly beside the forged maritime mortgage.
Now let’s inspect Exhibit One—your own hotel check-in from last night, Deputy.

nodes.headline: Suite 402 Exposed
nodes.teaser_text: Caught between a hotel keycard and a 14-year-old bank ledger, the corrupt deputy’s empire of lies begins to shatter.

nodes.text: 10:02 AM · Hearing Room 300. City Land Commissioners lean forward in shock as Evelyn displays the hotel access evidence.

nodes.caption: Suite 402 Master Keycard & access log: registered to the Land Registry Deputy on the night of the Pier 7 break-in.

nodes.text: Check the timeline: at 9:30 PM the Deputy met IronAnchor’s boss in Suite 402. At 11:19 PM, his burner phone pinged inside Pier 7’s boathouse—trying to burn our payoff stub!
Wait—IronAnchor’s boss just whispered to his bodyguards and slipped out the back corridor toward the harbor marina!
He’s trying to flee on his private yacht before the bank clearance officially lands on the Commissioner’s desk!

nodes.prompt: Act 3 opens—two battles unfold at once inside the Registry and at the marina:

options.label: Alert coast guard to block the breakwater
options.player_reply_text: Have harbor police seal the marina channel right now—no private yacht leaves this bay today!

options.label: Present the 14-year-old bank clearance now
options.player_reply_text: Stay focused on the Commissioners! Hand over the Central Maritime Bank clearance matching our Harbor Seal—kill the foreclosure permanently!

nodes.text: Patrol cutters just deployed across the breakwater! IronAnchor’s yacht is boxed in!
The Chief Commissioner just stamped IronAnchor’s mortgage VOID in giant red ink!
The corrupt Deputy collapses back into his chair as economic police read him his rights—Act 3 reaches full throttle.
One down, two to go. Now let’s put the 14-year-old payoff ledger on the official record.

nodes.headline: Act 3 · The Payoff Ledger
nodes.teaser_text: With the foreclosure dead and the marina sealed, Uncle Richard realizes the cartel is about to silence him—and cracks.

nodes.text: 10:35 AM · City Land Registry Atrium. Morning sun illuminates the marble pillars as the Chief Commissioner formally certifies the 14-year-old payoff.
Official decree signed! Horizon Waterfront is 100% debt-free and permanently vested in Nina’s name—IronAnchor’s claim is legally dead!
They even restored my father’s shipping honor roll in the harbor archive! Look—the press is asking how a "mechanic from Table 19" beat a port cartel!
Tell them we’re not done yet. IronAnchor’s boss sabotaged your father’s ship fifteen years ago—he doesn’t get to sail away.
[urgent message via duty counsel] Nolan, Nina—the Deputy just turned on us! IronAnchor’s boss threatened to silence me in custody if I talk!

nodes.prompt: Uncle Richard is terrified and ready to spill IronAnchor’s escape plan:

options.label: Tell Richard to give the yacht route to police
options.player_reply_text: If you want protective custody, Richard, tell economic police the EXACT cove where IronAnchor’s boss hid his speedboat!

options.label: Demand he confess the 15-year ship sabotage
options.player_reply_text: Confess everything on record—how you and IronAnchor sabotaged Nina’s father’s ship fifteen years ago—and give police his escape cove!

nodes.text: I’ll tell you! He’s NOT on the big yacht—that’s a decoy! He’s launching a black speedboat from North Breakwater Cove at 11:15 AM!
Yes, I took his bribe fifteen years ago to cut the cargo manifest! Now hurry—he’s slipping out of North Breakwater Cove in twenty minutes!
You relay North Breakwater Cove straight to the Harbor Police Commander as patrol sirens roar to life across the bay.
Harbor patrol just spotted the black speedboat near North Breakwater! Let’s head to the pier overlook!

nodes.headline: Richard’s Betrayal
nodes.teaser_text: Richard sells out his own cartel boss to save his skin—triggering a high-speed intercept at the harbor breakwater.

nodes.text: 11:12 AM · Harbor Breakwater Overlook. Bright noon sun flashes off white spray as three police cutters corner a black speedboat.
Look through the binoculars! IronAnchor’s boss just cut his engines and raised his hands—the harbor police have him boxed in!
And economic police just recovered a waterproof briefcase from his boat—packed with fifteen years of kickback ledgers tying him directly to Uncle Richard!

nodes.transcript: [panicked voice from custody] "Nina, please! I gave you his boat location—tell the judge I’m your only blood relative left!"

nodes.text: Blood relative? You auctioned my father’s memory, mocked the man I love at Table 19, and helped destroy Dad’s ships. I have no uncle.

nodes.prompt: Harbor police escort the cartel boss onto the pier right below you:

options.label: Hold Nina’s hand & watch justice land
options.player_reply_text: It’s over, Nina. Fifteen years of waiting—and today your father’s name is finally cleared.

options.label: Deliver the briefcase copy to prosecutors
options.player_reply_text: Evelyn, make sure prosecutors attach Richard’s fifteen-year kickback ledger to the main indictment—zero plea deals!

nodes.text: Thank you for never letting go of my hand, Nolan. Even when they pushed us behind the kitchen door.
Already logged! Prosecutors confirmed maximum sentencing across all three conspirators!
Suddenly, your phone buzzes—Uncle Richard is using his single allowed custody call to beg Nina one last time.
It’s Richard from the police station. Let’s end this cleanly so he never haunts us again.

nodes.headline: The Harbor Call
nodes.teaser_text: One final phone call from custody closes the book on Uncle Richard’s greed forever.

nodes.text: 11:30 AM · Harbor Overlook. Seagulls wheel overhead in the bright sky as Uncle Richard’s custody call connects.
[broken voice] "Nina... Nolan... I was blind with greed. Please don’t let them take my pension too—I’m sorry I put you at Table 19!"

nodes.transcript: [weeping voicemail] "I’m sorry, Nina! Greed ruined my whole life—I never should have betrayed your father or mocked Table 19!"

nodes.text: Table 19 wasn’t an insult, Richard. It was the best seat in the house—because it showed us who truly stood by Nina when she had nothing.
The Land Registry Chair just called—they’re holding a public press ceremony at 2:00 PM to hand Nina the permanent, unencumbered Harbor Title!

nodes.prompt: How should you and Nina celebrate clearing her father’s name?

options.label: Place the Jade Seal at her father’s memorial
options.player_reply_text: First, let’s stop by the waterfront cliff overlooking her father’s old berth and show him the Harbor Seal is finally home.

options.label: Commission a marble Table 19 at the park
options.player_reply_text: Evelyn, tell the Horizon Park architects to build a permanent marble viewing table right on the pier—engraved "Table 19"!

nodes.text: You always know my heart better than anyone, Nolan. Dad would be so proud to call you his son.
Oh, what a legendary touch! Every couple in the city will want their photo taken at Table 19!
At 2:00 PM, sunlight floods the Grand Registry Hall as city officials, press, and harbor workers pack the room.
Ready to claim your family’s harbor forever, Nina?

nodes.headline: The Grand Registry Hearing
nodes.teaser_text: In front of the entire city, the $90M waterfront deed and the Jade Harbor Seal return home for good.

nodes.text: 2:00 PM · Grand Registry Hall. Flashbulbs pop as the Chief Commissioner places the gold-stamped Harbor Title and Jade Seal into Nina’s hands.
It’s official! Every forged IronAnchor lien is expunged from the city archive, and Horizon Waterfront’s full $90M valuation is unlocked!
And thank you to the dockworkers who waited fifteen years for my father’s port to reopen—every single one of you has a job waiting on Monday!
My investment group is matching another $50M to turn the old piers into a clean maritime park and free trade-school workshop for young mechanics!
The dockworkers just erupted into a standing ovation! Meanwhile, the criminal court just wrapped up the arraignment of IronAnchor’s boss and Uncle Richard!

nodes.prompt: Reporters ask what you’ll do with the famous Jade Box itself:

options.label: Display it in the Horizon Maritime Museum
options.player_reply_text: We’re placing the Jade Box and Harbor Seal in a glass pavilion at the new waterfront—so the city never forgets honest craftsmanship.

options.label: Auction a charity replica to fund scholarships
options.player_reply_text: Keep the original safe in our museum, and let Evelyn auction a commemorative gold replica next month for dockworkers’ children’s tuition!

nodes.text: My father would have loved that more than any vault on earth.
Count me in! I’ll waive every cent of Sovereign’s commission—and I’ll reserve Table 19 as the seat of honor!
Outside the courthouse steps, the final gavel falls on the port cartel that terrorized the bay for fifteen years.
News flash: the entire IronAnchor cartel just folded—total collapse!

nodes.headline: The Cartel Falls
nodes.teaser_text: With every conspirator behind bars, the harbor awakens to a golden morning—and one unforgettable surprise at Table 19.

nodes.text: 4:30 PM · Horizon Waterfront Pier. Warm golden afternoon light shimmers over the bay as Evelyn reads the final court summary.
All three verdicts are in: IronAnchor’s boss gets 22 years, the corrupt Land Registry Deputy gets 14 years, and Uncle Richard gets 12 years with zero parole.
And the city just officially renamed the entire bay promenade "Horizon Heritage Harbor" after my father’s shipping line!
Not bad for a "poor mechanic" who got shoved beside the kitchen door, huh?
You were always the richest man in the room to me, Nolan—even before I ever saw your black card.

nodes.prompt: Tomorrow morning is the Grand Opening of Horizon Waterfront Park—you have one secret tucked in your pocket:

options.label: Prepare a sunrise proposal at Table 19
options.player_reply_text: Evelyn, keep the new marble "Table 19" on the pier clear at 9:30 AM tomorrow—I have one final bid to make.

options.label: Have Nina’s father’s brass bell restored
options.player_reply_text: Find her father’s original brass ship bell from Pier 7 and polish it bright gold—we’re ringing it together tomorrow morning!

nodes.text: Oh!! Say no more—I’ll have white roses, string musicians, and my golden gavel ready on the pier!
Already polished and mounted beside Table 19! Tomorrow morning is going to be pure magic!
You slip a velvet ring box back into your jacket pocket as sunset paints the calm harbor gold.
Rest well tonight, Nina. Tomorrow morning, Table 19 becomes ours forever.

nodes.headline: One Final Bid
nodes.teaser_text: Morning sunlight meets the newly opened Horizon Waterfront—where Table 19 seals the greatest love story of all.

nodes.text: 9:30 AM · Horizon Waterfront Park Grand Opening. Sparkling morning sunlight dances across the bay as crowds gather around a gleaming marble table engraved "Table 19."
Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to Horizon Heritage Harbor! Beneath this glass pavilion rests the authentic Jade Box and Harbor Seal—restored forever!
Look at that brass plaque with my father’s name... and a permanent marble Table 19 right beside the sea! Nolan, did you plan all this?
I bought the Jade Box for twelve million, won back a ninety-million harbor, and beat a port cartel—yet the only treasure I ever wanted is standing right in front of me.
[kneeling beside Table 19 with a gleaming diamond ring] Nina, will you marry me—and share Table 19 for the rest of our lives?

nodes.prompt: Nina’s eyes shine with happy tears as Evelyn raises her golden gavel:

options.label: Slip the ring on & kiss her in the sun
options.player_reply_text: Yes—a thousand times yes! Come here, my forever!

options.label: Ring her father’s brass ship bell together
options.player_reply_text: Seal our vow by ringing your father’s golden ship bell together—let the whole harbor hear our new beginning!

nodes.text: YES!! Forever and always, Nolan! From the kitchen door to the whole horizon!
CLANG! Going once, going twice... SOLD to Table 19 for eternity!!
White doves lift off into the bright blue sky as the whole harbor erupts in cheers—and Table 19 shines in morning gold.
Best seat in the world, Nolan—always Table 19.

nodes.headline: Grand Finale · Harbor Of Gold
nodes.teaser_text: The port cartel and Uncle Richard are behind bars, the $90M Heritage Harbor blooms anew, and Table 19 won the greatest prize of all—forever.
